name: qa-team
description: 质量保障团队：编排测试策略、API/UI 执行与独立复核，覆盖接口回归、E2E、安全与发版门禁；按变更选择最小充分回归，依赖/API 替换纳入受影响调用路径验证。

description_i18n.en: QA team orchestrating risk-based test design, API/UI execution and independent review for regression, E2E, security and release gates. Selects minimum-sufficient coverage by change; dependency/API replacements include affected call paths.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 质量保障团队：编排测试策略、API/UI 执行与独立复核，覆盖接口回归、E2E、安全与发版门禁；按变更选择最小充分回归，依赖/API 替换纳入受影响调用路径验证。
